verdict.rationale: USPTO publishes its own application-timeline page with tables of average wait times for new trademark applications and for each stage of examination and registration, which delivers stage-specific processing times. Patents get only a bare 'First action estimator' link with no description of what it reports. missing for 10: evidence the published times are current (update date or cadence), the actual table contents, documented processing times for patent and other transaction types, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: The tables below show the average wait times for new applications and each stage of the examination or registration process.
